text.p: Shares in Centennial Technologies Inc fell sharply on Monday because of a critical article in FinancialWorld magazine, traders said.

The Billerica, Mass., company's shares were off 4-7/8 to 29-1/8 in heavy trade. The 14-percent drop put the company, a producer of personal computer cards and a contract maker of computer parts, among leading decliners on the New York Stock Exchange. Asked about the drop, a trader said, "It's because of the negative article in FinancialWorld."

Among other points, the report questioned Centennial's accounting procedures and chief executive Emanuel Pinez' business and academic history. The story also reported on conflicting claims about a possible contract with AT&T Corp .
Don Peck, a Centennial spokesman, said the stock's drop was caused by "bad press" and the company had issued no news that could prompt the fall.
A company spokesman was not immediately available later to comment on the FinancialWorld article.
